In early [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the resurgent [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] splinter group known as the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] orchestrated the '''bombing''' of the [[Peace Park/Legends|Peace Park's]] [[Memorial Shrine]] in the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorian]] capital of [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]] on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]].

==The bombing==
The bomb was detonated by a [[Death Watch bomber/Legends|member]] of the Death Watch while [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] were walking through the [[Peace Park/Legends|Peace Park]] gardens. The explosion resulted in numerous injuries to those caught in the blast zone.

In the bomb's wake, a [[holograph]]ic display of Death Watch's symbol was left behind, and while the Duchess was escorted away from the scene by Kenobi and [[Mandalorian Royal Guard/Legends|her guards]], the Jedi Master ordered that everyone present be questioned. The bomber, watching silently from the crowd up until then, broke into a fleeing sprint with Kenobi giving chase. When he caught up with the bomber on a dead-end balcony, the Death Watch member opened fire on the Jedi with a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]]. However, after a brief tussle that ended with the loss of his weapon, and facing incarceration, the bomber instead chose to leap from the balcony's rail to his death on the ground below.
